opportunities.title: Ledger Didn't Get Hacked — Its Supply Chain Did (And That's Worse)
opportunities.why_now: Ledger is investigating $86-87M in losses traced to a Southeast Asian reseller, meaning the device wasn't compromised — the trust chain around it was.
opportunities.angle: Security breakdown explainer: walk through how reseller-level tampering bypasses hardware wallet guarantees, and what 'verify before you trust' actually means in practice.

opportunities.title: Vitalik Just Told You to Start Hoarding Quantum-Safe Keys. He's Not Wrong.
opportunities.why_now: Justin Drake and Vitalik are publicly floating 'bunker mode' over AI-accelerated cryptanalysis, a rare moment of core devs admitting the timeline might be months, not decades.
opportunities.angle: Myth-vs-reality piece: separate the hype from the actual cryptographic risk, then give a concrete action list (migrate to quantum-resistant addresses, audit key exposure) — tie in Zcash's Jan quantum-resistant target as proof this is already moving from theory to roadmap.

opportunities.title: XRP Ledger Had an Infinite-Money Bug for 10 Years. Nobody Found It Until Now.
opportunities.why_now: A decade-old vulnerability that could've minted unlimited XRP was just patched — a live case study in how 'audited and battle-tested' can still hide catastrophic bugs.
opportunities.angle: Post-mortem breakdown: what the bug was, why a decade of scrutiny missed it, and what it implies about every other 'mature' chain nobody's double-checking anymore.

opportunities.title: One Year After the $19B Liquidation Cascade, Crypto Made the Same Mistakes Smaller
opportunities.why_now: CoinDesk's anniversary retrospective on the $19B wipeout lands right as leverage, prediction markets, and lending are all creeping back up — the perfect 'told you so' moment.
opportunities.angle: Anniversary autopsy in the channel's signature voice: list what changed (less leverage concentration) vs. what didn't (same incentive structures), closing with a prediction of the next flashpoint.

opportunities.title: Crypto Lending Is Back. So Are All the Reasons It Blew Up Last Time.
opportunities.why_now: Cointelegraph's own reporting flags lending's resurgence without resolved risk controls, right alongside a fresh $35M Mashinsky settlement reminder of exactly how this movie ends.
opportunities.angle: Pattern-recognition piece pairing the lending resurgence with the Celsius settlement as bookends — 'the sequel nobody asked for' framing, with a checklist for spotting the next Celsius before it's a headline.
